CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books.
   C. Say The New Testament Books has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The New Testament Books to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Background of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background of Prophet Amos.
   C. Use Background of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Background of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   B. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Exodus? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Exodus to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Exodus has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Exodus.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.
   D. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Redemption after the Fall of Man and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship Over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain The Exodus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Sinai Covenant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Background of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of The Exodus with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. A — Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Redemption after the Fall of Man; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Stewardship Over Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Exodus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Sinai Covenant; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
